sequence_design.rule: Restore each repeat from the original interleaved loader; preserve within-repeat order in each path/token-matched pool. Select start + global request_id, without wraparound.
sequence_design.matching: Exact fallback reason and nearest valid token count, as in the original chooser. Timing-error records are excluded as in the original.
sequence_design.scope: Six fixed conditional replay settings, not six independent hardware trials. Three original measurement repeats each supply two blocks; fallback blocks may overlap.

design.hold_intervention: At deadline expiration hold the currently applied vector and mark fallback=True. Preserve busy-until-compute-ready, skipped ticks, discarded late result, and all other zero fallback causes.

statistics.sequence_uncertainty: Report each block and descriptive spread across six blocks; do not count 144 trajectories as independent episodes or infer a hardware-population CI.

design.reproduction_gate: All 240 legacy metrics and semantic events must reproduce before either new phase.
design.scientific_stop_rule: Finish the fixed design regardless of effect direction. No retraining, reselection, added blocks, or positive-effect threshold.
